info.name: SafeChat Presidio Server
info.description:
Complete test suite for the SafeChat Presidio FastAPI server.

Endpoints:
- GET  /health      — liveness check
- POST /analyze     — detect PII entities (no masking)
- POST /anonymize   — mask PII entities
- POST /sanitize    — analyze + anonymize in one call

Pre-requisites:
1. Start the server:  uvicorn main:app --port 8000 --reload
2. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable if using a different port.

variable.description: Base URL of the running Presidio server
